description:
About the Role

We are currently looking for a highly skilled DevOps Engineer who combines hands-on software development experience with a solid DevOps background. This position is ideal for professionals with a strong foundation in backend or full-stack development (preferably Java) who have transitioned into modern DevOps practices and enjoy working with scalable infrastructure and automation.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will work on the development, automation and optimization of modern cloud-native infrastructures. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams, contribute to smooth deployment processes and ensure stable, efficient and secure environments across applications and services.

Your main responsibilities include:
• Developing and optimizing CI/CD pipelines
• Working with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code
• Managing Kubernetes clusters, including deployment, operations and troubleshooting
• Implementing containerization strategies and working in cloud environments
• Using modern DevOps tooling and automation practices to improve overall system performance

Requirements

• 2–3+ years of professional DevOps experience
• Hands-on background in software development (Full-Stack or Backend), ideally with Java
• Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, Terraform and Kubernetes
• Familiarity with containerization and cloud technologies
• Understanding of DevOps principles, automation and modern infrastructure concepts
• Strong analytical mindset and a collaborative working style

What We Offer

• A modern tech environment with room for innovation
• Projects with well-known companies and enterprise-level engineering challenges
• The opportunity to contribute to high-impact infrastructure decisions
• A supportive and experienced engineering culture

Interested?

If this role aligns with your background and career goals, we’d be happy to provide more details about the project, team and technical setup.

Please feel free to reach out, we look forward to hearing from you.
nivel: Middle (2-5 ani), Senior (5-10 ani), Executive (>10 ani)
